Stream pod logs

Source: R/kube_verbs.R
kube_logs.Rd

Stream pod logs

Usage

kube_logs(
  k,
  pod,
  namespace = k$namespace,
  container = NULL,
  tail = NULL,
  follow = FALSE,
  previous = FALSE,
  since_seconds = NULL
)

Arguments

k

A Kube session.

pod

Pod name.

namespace

Namespace.

container

Optional container name (required for multi-container pods).

tail

Optional integer; only the last N lines.

follow

If TRUE, stream until the pod exits or the connection drops.

previous

If TRUE, fetch logs from a previously-terminated container.

since_seconds

Only return logs newer than this many seconds.

Value

A character string with the log content (or invisible NULL when follow=TRUE, with content emitted via cat()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
k <- kube()
cat(kube_logs(k, "nginx-abc", namespace = "default", tail = 50))
} # }
